policy.rule: Never rewrite or delete an accepted event. Supersede it with a later event that names the earlier decision ID.

events.decision: The footer is the sole inverse customer surface in the active light-system lane.
A 12px metadata floor and 15–16px customer body floor are proposed accessibility guardrails. They are not inherited champion authority until the champion user explicitly approves them.
All newly built or reconciled Figma and Sites artifacts remain CANDIDATE · HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, unpublished and unpromoted until a later artifact-specific visual approval is recorded.
Every future Make and Codex Sites prompt must contain INHERITED_CHAMPION_STATE, THIS_RUN_DELTA and DO_NOT_INHERIT blocks. A later board is never imported as an unqualified full-state instruction.
Sequence components and foundations before page candidates, page candidates before runtime translation, and responsive/final gates before publication, Code Connect or runtime promotion.

MF-01A's complete color inventory is authoritative. The CONV-001 convergence palette missed the graduated border hierarchy (border-chip #D4E0F2, border-outer #BECFE9, border-identity #BDD0F1, border-inner #B4CAF0, border-family-bg #D9E3F1) and chip value text (#17213F). These are now added as convergence variables. Codex must not invent color values; every fill and stroke must resolve to a convergence variable.

QualitativeChip uses MF-01A two-type grammar: icon-led container with label (Inter Medium 11px, tracking 0.66px, UPPER, text/muted #64718A) above value (Inter Bold 12px, tracking 0.24px, text/chip-value #17213F). Container fill surface/card, stroke border/chip #D4E0F2, radius 10px. The single-line label chip pattern is rejected.

Media chamber uses MF-01A atmospheric diagonal gradient (#F8FBFF at 5% → #E4ECFA at 100%) not a solid fill. surface/media #F0F4FB remains available as fallback for small contexts only. neutral/family updated from #FAFCFF to MF-01A's #F8FAFC.

The MF-01A atmospheric media gradient remains governed by DEC-MEDIA-001 even though its #F8FBFF and #E4ECFA paint stops are literal Figma gradient-stop colors. This is an explicit bounded exception to the otherwise zero-invented-color and variable-binding rule: components must use the exact two-stop paint recipe, the exception must be visible in validation receipts, and no additional unbound paint color is authorized.

The complete MF-01A atmospheric media recipe contains two governed literal gradients: the outer chamber #F8FBFF to #E4ECFA and the contact shelf #FFFFFF to #E6EDFA. Both exceptions are limited to the exact authored media-chamber construction. Every other component fill and stroke remains required to resolve through the active convergence variables.

Shop discovery preserves the runtime-owned family taxonomy (SARMs, Research Chemicals, Prohormones and Stacks) and models goal, form, servings or pack size, and availability as independent, combinable facets. The established header navigation remains the shell information architecture; category navigation and filter facets must not be collapsed into one mixed taxonomy. Figma and Codex Sites consume a read-only contract and do not become live catalogue or inventory authority.

events.decision: Repeated MK-2866 Vertical-card fixture data is acceptable when the review job is to prove the shared component contract, geometry, material, responsive behavior or states. Product-slot diversification belongs to runtime publication and catalogue data; it is not required to validate the Vertical contract and never authorizes fabricated product truth.

MF runs are paired Figma and Codex Sites candidate runs. Each run advances design, commerce, experience and UX/UI together through synchronized Figma, repository and proof projections. This paired candidate work finishes what Figma Make began, but it remains presentation authority only: publication, production adoption and every live runtime owner remain separately gated behind artifact-specific MF-10 champion approval and a later independently authorized MF++ packet.

Every canonical card that owns a media chamber must use a populated, confirmed product render to prove adaptive crop, scale, safe area and the MF-01A atmospheric construction. Empty placeholder chambers are rejected for adaptive proof. PurchasePanel contains no media chamber by design, so media-population acceptance is not applicable to PurchasePanel; it must not receive an invented chamber.

Use a repository-owned, executable Figma-to-code bridge as the current Code Connect workaround. The bridge maps exact Figma nodes to typed React exports, route sources and governed tokens; exposes an identical read-only JSON resource for Codex, MCP, SSR-inventory or a later FastAPI adapter; and rejects stale pseudo paths by execution. Official Code Connect mapping, hosting, publication and runtime adoption remain separately gated and were not invoked.

MF-09 node 881:2675 and MF-10 node 888:304 are execution and control receipts, not sufficient visual-approval surfaces. Champion visual review must use artifact-specific boards that place native Figma evidence beside validated Sites captures, plus direct canonical component and route nodes. Receipt validation never implies champion approval.

The future Account and Retention composition is a C-led Retention Lab hybrid.
